reports.desc: I rented a vehicle from enterprise while my car was being repaired.  I rented the vehicle from June 8th- 12th. When I returned the rental the car was signed off from any damage.  Then about 6 weeks later I received a letter demanding money for damage to the vehicle. I went over to enterprise in Galesburg, Il where I  rented the vehicle from. I was told that if the claim was under 1000 then they wouldn't presume it. I was given a claim number and phone number to contact the claims department.  When I called I was told there wasn't anything under my name or claim number. I thought that would be the end of it. This past Friday I received a text and phone number about the same claim number. I was told I did damage the car and now they say I damaged the carpet as well. I google this phone number 866-3004407. It states this is a scam claiming damage was done to a vehicle rented from enterprise.

I placed two orders with this website a week apart. First order #129375 was placed on 7/1/26 and I received an order conformation and transaction number 202607012244072534. The second order was placed on 7/7/26 order #129379. The amount for both purchases were charged on my visa gift card (reloadable card). I have never received the merchandise or any replies to my numerous emails and letters sent. This website has NO Phone number...? They have a service email but it does not work. Messages get timed out and not delivered? No way to contact them I even called the building they are located in and they could not connect me either...  I do believe I have been scammed out of $235...
I received a text claiming to be GMD management about my house going to auction soon.
Ordered online. Package says delivered, but was not. Company will not provide POD. Company said they reshipped, still not delivered. Tracking numbers do not work. Company will not provide carrier.

I paid for and supposedly took an IQ test. I was charged $1.95 through PayPal. Today, August 27, 2027 I received a PayPal notice authorizing $39.95 For Nordica lab. I did not authorize any additional payments to Nordicsl lab. In fact test was incorrect. I do not want to pay Nordica lab any further amount. I paid the initial amount as requested for the supposed results.
I have contacted PayPal to deny amount but now have opened a case. What else do I need to do?
I received a text message from the number posing to be my morgage company. They set up a phone call and had known the amount of my loan and stated they needed to set up morgage protection
I received a text from a Michigan phone number that stated, "Payment Confirmation #. Your donation to Jon Ossoff has been verified. Click here for details: https://e.givact.com/KCpWgNtl0Mk".
I received a small mailer delivered to my current address but using my maiden name. When I opened the mailer, the only thing inside was a clipping of another USPS mailer pouch.

I booked a cruise through this person.  I was told it was paid in full and we were "all set".  I checked on the cruise website and yes,  the cruise was booked!!  I was emailed by connie this week that all reservation are being canceled and that her company is no more.   Where's my money?  I contacted the cruise line and yes,  she canceled it,  but she had only placed a non refundable deposit of $500.  I was told it was paid in full.... where's the rest?   Also, in order for me to use the $500, I need the TRAVEL ADVISOR to sign off on it,..... which she can't because her attorney won't allow her to speak to clients.  After reading other peoples struggles with the agent,  I consider myself lucky it wasn't a larger amount.

I received an email from the sender l who is an old college friend. It was a paperless post e-invite which of course I trusted. But, something seemed off because when I clicked the link to sign in, to view the invitation, it took me to my email. That spoofed me so I quickly changed my password and signed out all of my devices. I’m not positive his email was hacked and they are trying to get people in his contacts.

I got scammed out of a product that was too good to be true. I shouldve known better when the adress they listed lead to either a warehouse in the middle of nowhere or just a tall building that showed no trace of the shop as shown on the website. After cancelling and receiving a new card, I still kept getting failed "delivery" attempts shown on their postal tracker.
Product is supposed to project moving images on ceilings....it does nothing.
I ordered the pants I never received they keep saying they are on their way. No tracking one no email respond.  Order #SOV29780 tracking number DZT9387429689U.
